label: Handling a problem or incident
summary: Accountable, empathetic, and calm incident communication
Direct explanation of root cause and remediation progress
No shifting of blame or downplaying of customer disruption
tone_principles: Serious, humble, accountable, and reassuring. Avoid defensive or dismissive wording.
writing_style: Concise factual chronology, clear timeline of steps taken, and direct contact avenues.
messaging_principles: Acknowledge inconvenience honestly, detail safeguards against recurrence, and honor customer trust.

rules.title: Avoid Dismissive or Blame-Shifting Incident Language
rules.description: Incident communications must never dismiss customer impact or shift responsibility.

suggested_replacements.not our fault at all: our team takes full ownership of service restoration
suggested_replacements.users are overreacting: we understand the frustration this service disruption caused
suggested_replacements.minor glitch with zero consequences: we are investigating the scope and impact of this service interruption
suggested_replacements.nobody was actually harmed: we deeply apologize for the disruption to your workflow

rules.do_example: We sincerely apologize for the service disruption and have deployed a hotfix.
rules.dont_example: It was not our fault at all and users are overreacting to a minor glitch.

terminology.notes: Incident communications must respect customer disruption.
